raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.15.1"
  name: gap-split

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/gap-system/gap/releases/download/v${{ version }}/gap-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6049d53e99b12e25c2d848db21ac4a06380a46fe4c4157243d556fe06930042c
  patches:
    - 0001-Allow-cross-building-packages.patch
    - 0002-Do-not-run-prerequisites.sh.patch
    - 0003-Build-with-planarity-4.patch

build:
  number: 5
  skip: win

outputs:
  # Builds GAP and all its packages once; the outputs below pick their files
  # from the resulting work directory.
  - staging:
      name: gap-build
    build:
      script: build.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: unix
          then: gnuconfig
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - make
        - pkgconf
        - curl
        - automake
        - libtool
      host:
        # Since we are using bin/buildpackages.sh to build all packages at once,
        # these requirements are needed.
        - gmp
        - readline
        - ncurses                    # for package Browse
        - curl                       # for package curlInterface
        # GAP uses the old header layout of cddlib that changed in 0.94k; we do not
        # build a cdd interface until this is fixed upstream; see #79.
        # - cddlib                   # for package cddInterface
        - mpfr                       # for package float
        - mpfi                       # for package float
        - mpc                        # for package float
        - pari                       # for package alnuth
        - zeromq                     # for package ZeroMQInterface
        - libsemigroups >=2.7.4,<3   # for package Semigroups
        - planarity >=4,<5           # for package digraphs
        - bliss                      # for package digraphs
        # libnormaliz fails to detect the normaliz headers, see #84; build.sh
        # removes NormalizInterface, so we do not need normaliz (or libflint).
        # - normaliz                 # for package NormalizInterface
        # - libflint                 # for package NormalizInterface -> normaliz -> e-antic -> libflint
        - zlib

  - package:
      name: gap-core
    inherit:
      from: gap-build
      # Only the packages each output links against belong in its dependencies.
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script: install-core.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - libtool
        - make
      host:
        - gmp
        - readline
        - zlib
    tests:
      - script:
          - gap -h
      - script: run_test.sh

  - package:
      name: gap-defaults
    inherit:
      from: gap-build
      # Only the packages each output links against belong in its dependencies.
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script: install-defaults.sh
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-core', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script: run_test.sh

  # The GAP CAS with all packages that we could manage to build.
  # Eventually, we might want to split this into separate gap- packages so that
  # it is possible to install just a subset of those. (Some, such as
  # cddinterface conflict with other systems such as sage.)
  - package:
      name: gap
    inherit:
      from: gap-build
      # Only the packages each output links against belong in its dependencies.
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script: install-full.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - libtool
        - make
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python *
            - setuptools <60
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - gmp
        - readline
        - ncurses             # for package Browse
        # GAP uses the old header layout of cddlib that changed in 0.94k; we do
        # not build cddInterface until this is fixed upstream, see #79.
        # - cddlib
        - libcurl                    # for package curlInterface
        - mpfr                       # for package float
        - mpfi                       # for package float
        - mpc                        # for package float
        - pari                       # for package alnuth
        - zeromq                     # for package ZeroMQInterface
        - libsemigroups >=2.7.4,<3   # for package Semigroups
        - planarity >=4,<5           # for package digraphs
        - bliss                      # for package digraphs
        # libnormaliz fails to detect the normaliz headers, see #84.
        # - normaliz                   # for package NormalizInterface
        # - libflint                   # for package NormalizInterface -> normaliz -> e-antic -> libflint <=2.6.0
        # The xgap package fails to detect the libX11 headers, see #83.
        # - xorg-libx11                # for package xgap
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-core', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-defaults', exact=True) }}
        # For JupyterKernel
        - setuptools <60
        - python *
        - pip
      run:
        # pin_compatible() requires 4ti2 in host, which it never was.
        - if: x86_64
          then: 4ti2
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-core', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gap-defaults', exact=True) }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
          - if: build_platform != target_platform
            then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    tests:
      - script: run_test.sh

about:
  homepage: https://www.gap-system.org/
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: GAP - Groups, Algorithms, Programming, a System for Computational Discrete Algebra
  repository: https://github.com/gap-system/gap
  documentation: https://docs.gap-system.org/doc/ref/chap0_mj.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
    - saraedum
